newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-General Gold to explore Gawler Craton.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-General Gold to explore Gawler Craton.

text.p: Gold explorer General Gold Resources Nl said on Monday it will shortly start a drilling programme to explore two promising copper/gold targets in the Lake Torrens area of South Australia's highly prospective Gawler Craton.

General Gold said the two propects are Carrapateena and Wilga. The Wilga prospect lies at the southern end of Lake Torrens in an area which has not been tested previously for copper-gold targets, while Carrapateena lies further north just to the west of Lake Torrens.
At 2.15 p.m. (0315 GMT), General Gold shares were 2.5 cents up at 49 cents. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
